Study Destinations for Myanmar Students

Explore mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan, Thailand, Malaysia and Singapore: study pathways, qualification recognition, student immigration and university introductions.

China

Explore mainland China, Hong Kong and Macao, and Taiwan in three parts. Each introduces regional study pathways and local universities. Check rules for the destination, applicant status and chosen course.

Mainland China

Explore mainland study options through universities in Beijing, Hangzhou and Xiamen. Chinese- and English-taught programmes are available. Check high school credential recognition, programme language and CSCA requirements, then prepare the study visa after admission.

Check your school qualification first

Myanmar Matriculation, Chinese-school diplomas, GED and A-Level need separate review. A general requirement for a high school diploma or equivalent does not automatically confirm every Myanmar qualification. Ask the university to review the school, study duration, diploma and full transcript.

  • 北京外国语大学2026年国际学生本科招生简章 ↗
  • Peking University: 2026 undergraduate entrance examination guide ↗

Prepare for the teaching language

Chinese-taught programs commonly use HSK; English-taught programs may request IELTS, TOEFL or evidence of English-medium education. Thresholds, section scores, validity and speaking-test requirements vary by program. Any exemption for Chinese-school or English-medium study needs university confirmation.

  • 北京航空航天大学2026国际本科招生 ↗
  • 北京外国语大学2026年国际学生本科招生简章 ↗

Understand the CSCA assessment

Many 2026 undergraduate guides require CSCA results. Tests may include mathematics, Professional Chinese, physics and chemistry. Subjects, test language and exemptions depend on the program. Check the CSCA website and the university directory.

  • Northeastern University 2026 undergraduate application guide ↗
  • 北京外国语大学2026年国际学生本科招生简章 ↗
  • CSCA官方考试网站 ↗

Build a complete application file

Prepare your diploma or expected-graduation certificate, all term results, language evidence and passport details. Provide translations or notarized copies as required for documents outside Chinese or English. Statements, references, guardian documents, portfolios and interviews vary by university and program.

  • 北京外国语大学2026年国际学生本科招生简章 ↗
  • Peking University: 2026 undergraduate entrance examination guide ↗

Check X1 or X2 for your study duration

The Chinese Embassy in Myanmar lists X1 for study longer than 180 days and X2 for study of no more than 180 days. After receiving university admission documents, follow the embassy’s current checklist. Admission and visa approval are separate decisions.

  • 中国驻缅甸使馆：中华人民共和国签证办理须知（2025年6月30日起启用，网页持续更新） ↗
  • Chinese Embassy in Myanmar: Introduction of Visa for the PRC (mainland) ↗

Use the current embassy checklist

X1 normally requires an admission letter and study documents such as JW201/JW202; X2 requires admission evidence and the other documents requested by the embassy. Check passport, identification and online application instructions directly with the Chinese Embassy in Myanmar.

  • 中国驻缅甸使馆：中华人民共和国签证办理须知（2025年6月30日起启用，网页持续更新） ↗
  • Chinese Embassy in Myanmar: Introduction of Visa for the PRC (mainland) ↗

Separate planning from an active intake

An earlier guide can help you plan, but dates, programs, language requirements and CSCA rules may change. Check the official guide and major directory for your intended intake. Matching results support shortlisting and advice; universities still assess qualifications, program readiness and admission.

  • 北京外国语大学2026年国际学生本科招生简章 ↗
  • Northeastern University 2026 undergraduate application guide ↗

Tsinghua University

A comprehensive research university in Beijing. Its fields include engineering, science, humanities, social sciences, management, medicine and art, with an undergraduate emphasis on engineering and interdisciplinary study.

  • Tsinghua University: General Information ↗
  • Tsinghua University: Undergraduate Overview ↗

Peking University

Founded in 1898 in Beijing, Peking University spans humanities, social sciences, natural sciences, information and engineering, and medicine. Its international undergraduate admission routes require separate review.

  • Peking University: 2026 undergraduate entrance examination guide ↗

Zhejiang University

Located in Hangzhou, Zhejiang University traces its roots to Qiushi Academy, founded in 1897. Its broad faculties and schools offer varied study options; compare the actual program, campus and admission route.

  • Zhejiang University: Official Overview ↗

Xiamen University

Founded by Tan Kah Kee in 1921, Xiamen University is a comprehensive university in Xiamen, Fujian, directly administered by China’s Ministry of Education. Explore its schools and international programs, then check the annual admission guide.

  • Xiamen University: Overview ↗

Hong Kong & Macao

Hong Kong and Macao offer comprehensive and science-focused research universities. Compare subjects, teaching languages and campus learning models. International admissions, student entry and stay procedures are handled separately in Hong Kong and Macao; Myanmar applicants should check their passport, qualifications and chosen course.

Hong Kong: choose the correct admission route

HKU and HKUST have international-qualification admission routes and assess academic, program-specific and English requirements. Check recognition of Myanmar school qualifications, GED or A-Level; an unlisted qualification may need individual review. Myanmar citizens of Chinese ancestry and Chinese citizens living overseas must confirm their route using actual nationality, residence and qualifications, rather than ethnicity or school name alone.

  • HKU International/Non-JUPAS Admissions ↗
  • HKUST International Qualifications ↗

Hong Kong: student visa or entry permit

After admission, check the Immigration Department’s study visa or entry-permit requirements. These include admission, a local sponsor, travel documents and financial-support evidence; applicants under 18 need to check guardian arrangements. Documents depend on nationality and residence status.

  • 香港入境事务处：来港就读 ↗

Macao: verify the international admission route

The University of Macau’s international application page is for foreign-passport holders. Check the accepted qualification, chosen program and teaching-language requirements; an interview may be needed. Myanmar citizens and Chinese citizens living overseas should confirm their applicable routes separately. Meeting one academic or language condition does not establish complete eligibility.

  • University of Macau: International undergraduate applicants ↗
  • University of Macau: Application Requirement ↗

Macao: special authorization to stay for study

Macao’s Public Security Police requires non-resident students at approved higher-education institutions to apply for Special Authorization to Stay before their entry permission expires. An admission letter does not automatically grant residence status. Check entry documents, authorization and extensions according to nationality, travel documents and university instructions.

  • 澳门治安警察局：外地学生逗留特别许可 ↗

The University of Hong Kong

HKU offers undergraduate programs across multiple disciplines and an International/Non-JUPAS admission route. Compare programs, English requirements and application materials on its official admissions site.

  • HKU International/Non-JUPAS Admissions ↗
  • HKU official university introduction entry (general homepage) ↗

The Chinese University of Hong Kong

Founded in 1963, CUHK is a comprehensive research university with a collegiate system and an emphasis on bilingual, multicultural and general education. Its faculties offer varied disciplines; international applicants should check the relevant admissions route and programme conditions.

  • CUHK official website: university and admissions navigation entry ↗
  • CUHK: Introducing the University ↗
  • CUHK: International admissions requirements ↗

The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

Founded in 1991, HKUST emphasizes research and innovation. International-qualification applicants must meet general, school/program and English requirements; unlisted qualifications may be assessed individually.

  • HKUST: About the university ↗
  • HKUST International Qualifications ↗
  • HKUST: Apply Now ↗

University of Macau

Founded in 1981, UM is a comprehensive public research university with English as its main teaching language. Its faculties span humanities, business, education, health sciences, law, science and technology, and social sciences, alongside residential colleges. Check language and international entry conditions for each course.

  • University of Macau official university introduction entry ↗
  • University of Macau: International undergraduate applicants ↗
  • University of Macau: Application Requirement ↗
  • University of Macau: Introduction ↗

Taiwan

Get to know study options through universities in Taipei, Hsinchu and Tainan. Courses may use Chinese, English or both. Explore institutions and subjects, then check international or overseas Chinese applicant status, language evidence and study residence rules.

International and overseas Chinese routes

International applicants must meet nationality and prior-study rules and generally apply to universities. Overseas Chinese status requires Chinese descent, qualifying overseas residence documents and birth/residence conditions, with official validation; routes include the overseas joint admissions committee or university direct admission. A Myanmar Chinese-school diploma alone does not establish this status. Check nationality, residence and previous study records first.

  • NTU — Student Status ↗
  • NCKU — Overseas Compatriot Direct Admission ↗

Programme language and documents

Programmes may use Chinese, English or both; check the current programme’s language evidence and thresholds. Prepare graduation records, full transcripts, nationality evidence and requested language documents. Recommendations, financial evidence, portfolios and interviews depend on the institution and programme. Translate and authenticate documents as required. Assess Taiwan programmes separately from mainland CSCA rules.

  • NTU OIA — Why Study at NTU ↗
  • NTU — International Students ↗
  • NCKU — Admission Information ↗
  • BOCA — Resident Visas for Foreign Students ↗

Study visa and residence: official portals

After admission, check the applicable study-visa procedure with the responsible Taiwan overseas mission. The foreign-student resident-visa checklist includes the form, passport, photos, admission evidence, health examination, education records and financial evidence; additional documents may be requested. Follow National Immigration Agency rules for an ARC after entry, using its student residence service where applicable. Use the route for your student status, rather than mainland X1 procedures.

  • BOCA — Resident Visas for Foreign Students ↗
  • National Immigration Agency — Student Residence Instructions ↗
  • BOCA — Online Visa Application ↗

National Taiwan University (NTU)

A national university in Taipei with varied degree and interdisciplinary study options. International programmes may use Chinese, English or both; check student status and programme requirements in its admissions portal.

  • NTU — About NTU ↗
  • NTU OIA — Why Study at NTU ↗
  • NTU — International Students ↗

National Tsing Hua University (NTHU)

Located in Hsinchu, with science, technology, engineering, humanities, social sciences and management. International and overseas Chinese applicants use distinct admission routes.

  • NTHU — About NTHU ↗
  • NTHU — International Students ↗

National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University (NYCU)

Formed in 2021 from Yang-Ming and Chiao Tung universities, combining biomedical and electronic-communications traditions with diverse academic fields. International degree applications use the university’s online system.

  • NYCU — About ↗
  • NYCU Secretariat — Campus Locations ↗
  • NYCU — Admissions Overview ↗
  • NYCU — International Admissions ↗

National Cheng Kung University (NCKU)

Based in Tainan, with engineering education, research and medical resources. Check international admissions for available programmes, documents and any interviews or tests; overseas Chinese direct admission has a separate route.

  • NCKU — Admission Information ↗

Thailand

Thailand offers international undergraduate programmes at public and private universities. Choose your subject and teaching language, then check qualification equivalency, subject results and the intake requirements.

Myanmar Matriculation: check equivalency

Provide the exam year, curriculum and total schooling years. MUIC’s 2025 guide does not accept Myanmar Matriculation alone as equivalent high school completion; it does not distinguish the new 12-year system. Ask MUIC for confirmation; other universities assess separately.

  • MUIC: High school qualification guide, May 2025 ↗

GED and A-Level: check each programme

Some international programmes accept complete GED or A-Level routes. Check GED subject and total scores, A-Level subjects and grades, and any O-Level, mathematics-test or interview requirements for the specific programme.

  • MUIC: Overseas undergraduate applicants ↗
  • MUIC: High school qualification guide, May 2025 ↗
  • Bangkok University: International programme admissions ↗

Myanmar Chinese-school diplomas: individual review

No universal acceptance rule for Myanmar Chinese-school-issued diplomas was verified. Send the school and awarding-body details, curriculum, study years and transcript to the target university for assessment.

  • MUIC: High school qualification guide, May 2025 ↗
  • Bangkok University: International programme admissions ↗

Teaching language and document certification

Check the programme’s IELTS overall score, individual bands and validity period. Submit the diploma and transcript, with English or Thai translation, certification and equivalency documents as required by the university.

  • MUIC: Overseas undergraduate applicants ↗
  • Bangkok University: International programme admissions ↗

Student visa preparation: obtain university documents

Obtain your offer and university visa-support documents. Confirm the applicable ED or ED Plus category with the university and responsible mission. Prepare your passport, photograph and any financial or police-clearance evidence requested in the current checklist.

  • Royal Thai Embassy Yangon: Education visa documents ↗
  • Royal Thai Embassy: Studying visa categories ↗
  • Royal Thai Embassy Yangon: Visa services ↗

Applying from Myanmar: use Thai e-Visa

For applications handled in Yangon, submit through Thai e-Visa and follow the embassy’s appointment instructions for payment. After approval, check entry validity and university arrival instructions. Applicants living elsewhere should follow their responsible mission.

  • Royal Thai Embassy Yangon: Visa services ↗

Chulalongkorn University

A public comprehensive university in Bangkok with science and other disciplines and international programmes. Its official profile emphasises research, innovation and service to society. Check the selected faculty and programme.

  • Chulalongkorn University: Introduction ↗
  • Chulalongkorn University: About and campus address ↗
  • Chulalongkorn University: Public university management ↗
  • Chulalongkorn: Faculty of Science ↗

Mahidol University

A public university with Salaya and Bangkok campuses, covering health sciences, science and other fields. Its International College, MUIC, offers international undergraduate programmes. Check the college and teaching language.

  • Mahidol University: University overview ↗
  • Mahidol University International College: Overview ↗

Bangkok University

A private university with its main campus in Pathum Thani. Its institutional history highlights business, communication and creative fields, practical learning and entrepreneurship. International programmes have their own entry requirements.

  • Bangkok University: History and educational focus ↗
  • Bangkok University: Main campus address ↗

Malaysia

Malaysia has public universities, private universities and foreign university campuses. Check qualification level, course requirements and English proficiency. Study immigration procedures commonly involve EMGS assessment and a Student Pass.

Matriculation: legacy and new-system pathways

MQA’s 2025 list places legacy Myanmar Matriculation, with 11 years of schooling, at foundation/certificate/diploma entry level. The 12-year high-school and Matriculation qualification starting in 2024 is listed at bachelor entry level. Universities still assess course eligibility.

  • MQA: International entry qualifications, December 2025 ↗
  • MQA: International qualification equivalency ↗

GED and A-Level: verify programme eligibility

MQA lists GED at bachelor entry level, but university and programme acceptance can differ. For A-Level, check the course’s subject and grade requirements; universities determine prerequisite subjects.

  • MQA: International entry qualifications, December 2025 ↗
  • MQA: International qualification equivalency ↗
  • Monash University Malaysia: Undergraduate study areas ↗

Myanmar Chinese-school diplomas and UEC are distinct

A Myanmar Chinese-school-issued diploma should not be treated as Malaysia’s UEC. Submit awarding-body details, curriculum, study years and the full transcript. Follow university and MQA equivalency instructions where necessary.

  • MQA: International qualification equivalency ↗

English results and document preparation

Check the course’s English requirements. EMGS requests English evidence and academic records; acceptance of IELTS does not establish one score for all courses. Follow the university and relevant authority’s translation and certification instructions.

  • EMGS: Required documents ↗
  • MQA: International qualification equivalency ↗
  • Monash University Malaysia: Undergraduate study areas ↗

Student Pass: obtain an offer first

After receiving an offer, apply for a Student Pass through the institution or EMGS. Prepare your passport, compliant photograph, offer, academic records, English evidence and health declaration; check any location-specific requirements.

  • EMGS: Required documents ↗
  • EMGS: Student Pass application steps ↗

After approval: entry visa and arrival formalities

After eVAL approval, Myanmar passport holders should obtain the required Single Entry Visa/eVISA under the current rules. Before travel, check applicable MDAC requirements and the university’s arrival instructions.

  • EMGS: Student Pass application steps ↗

After arrival: medical screening and pass endorsement

Complete the required post-arrival screening at an EMGS or university-registered clinic. The institution assists with Student Pass endorsement. Keep your immigration documents and confirm renewal and reporting requirements with the university.

  • EMGS: Student Pass application steps ↗
  • EMGS: Required documents ↗

Universiti Malaya

A public comprehensive research university in Kuala Lumpur. Its official profile covers medicine, science, engineering and technology, social sciences and humanities. Check language and subject requirements for the chosen undergraduate course.

  • Universiti Malaya: About UM, official staff onboarding ↗
  • Universiti Malaya: Official institutional profile in media statement ↗

Monash University Malaysia

The Malaysian campus of Australia’s Monash University, located in Bandar Sunway. Study areas include business, computing, engineering, science and medicine/health. Monash describes common academic quality standards across its campuses.

  • Monash University Malaysia: Welcome and governance ↗
  • Monash University Malaysia: Maps and transport ↗
  • Monash University Malaysia: Undergraduate study areas ↗

Sunway University

A not-for-profit private university in Sunway City, with business, engineering/technology, medical/life sciences and hospitality/tourism fields. Its official profile emphasises sustainability, planetary health research, innovation and entrepreneurship.

  • Sunway University: A brief introduction ↗

Singapore

Singapore offers local autonomous universities and overseas university campuses. Myanmar students should first distinguish bachelor, foundation and diploma routes, then check qualification acceptance, English requirements and Student’s Pass procedures.

Start with your qualification

Each university reviews the qualification and programme. NTU’s Myanmar Matriculation route requires supplementary AP or UK A-Level qualifications. Chinese-school certificates, GED and different A-Level boards need separate checks; the school’s teaching language alone does not establish acceptance.

  • NTU — Myanmar Matriculation Exam ↗

Study language and English evidence

English is a key study language. NUS teaches in English unless a course states otherwise. Accepted IELTS, TOEFL or instruction-language evidence varies by university, qualification and programme. HSK does not replace English entry requirements.

  • NUS — Education and medium of instruction ↗
  • NTU — Myanmar English language requirements ↗

Bachelor, foundation and diploma pathways

Bachelor admission is separate from foundation or diploma admission. JCU Singapore’s foundation prepares students for specified bachelor programmes. Some colleges offer diplomas; progression, grades and credit transfer require a specific agreement, with no automatic entry to NUS, NTU or SMU.

  • JCU Singapore — Pre-University Foundation Program ↗
  • PSB Academy — Myanmar entry requirements for selected diploma routes ↗

From programme choice to application

Choose a programme and check qualifications, prerequisites and language rules. Apply through the university with certificates, transcripts, passport details and required test evidence, including certified English translations where required. Follow up on documents and interviews, then accept the offer as instructed. Admission and Student’s Pass are separate reviews.

  • NTU — Myanmar application procedures ↗
  • JCU Singapore — International student admissions ↗

Student’s Pass: check the institution

Approved full-time study generally requires a Student’s Pass, subject to ICA exemptions. NUS, NTU and SMU use the IHL route. For private institutions, check EduTrust and use the PEI route. Part-time, evening and weekend courses are ineligible.

  • ICA — Student’s Pass overview ↗
  • ICA — Institutes of Higher Learning ↗
  • ICA — Approved Private Education Institutions ↗

Prepare registration and identity documents

Prepare the school’s Registration Acknowledgement Letter, passport biodata, applicable birth certificate, recent digital photo, and education, family, funding and Singapore address details. Non-English documents need official English translations accepted by ICA.

  • ICA — IHL documents required ↗
  • ICA — PEI documents required ↗

Apply online 2–3 months before study

For new IHL and PEI applications, ICA currently requires submission 2–3 months before the course starts. Use the school’s registration details and apply before travelling. Do not rely on extending a short visit while waiting.

  • ICA — IHL application procedure ↗
  • ICA — PEI new application procedure ↗

Complete formalities after IPA approval

After IPA approval, follow its document and medical instructions. Enter on a valid immigration pass, complete the school-arranged or ICA appointment and biometrics, then retrieve the digital Student’s Pass. Any required entry visa is included in the IPA.

  • ICA — Completion and digital Student’s Pass ↗

National University of Singapore (NUS)

A comprehensive autonomous university combining education, research and enterprise. Its multiple schools and interdisciplinary options support broad subject exploration; bachelor requirements remain programme-specific.

  • NUS — About ↗

Nanyang Technological University (NTU)

A technological autonomous university with engineering, computing and data science, business, science, humanities, arts and medicine. Myanmar Matriculation applicants should check its dedicated qualification page and subject prerequisites.

  • NTU — About and campuses ↗
  • MOE — Autonomous universities ↗

Singapore Management University (SMU)

A city-based autonomous university connecting management, social sciences and technology, with interactive and practice-oriented learning. Areas include business, accountancy, economics, computing and information systems, law and social sciences.

  • SMU — About and city campus ↗
  • MOE — Autonomous universities ↗

James Cook University, Singapore

JCU’s Australian-owned Singapore campus offers business, psychology, IT, science and tourism, plus pre-university pathways. Foundation entry and bachelor admission are separate, with progression limited to specified programmes and grades.

  • JCU — About the Singapore campus ↗
  • JCU — Foundation progression ↗
